sources.title: ASL University: hello
sources.author: William Vicars / ASL University
sources.demonstration_notes_zh: 文字说明支持自然的侧向左右挥手作为问候，并区分上下 flutter 的 hey。本次未从页面读取到正式数值或掌向参数。
sources.handshape: natural open-hand wave; numeric finger configuration unspecified
sources.palm_orientation: not explicitly fixed in the inspected text; implementation choice requires review
sources.location: hand in visible greeting space; exact height unspecified
sources.nonmanual: not established by inspected text; natural greeting expression still requires review

sources.title: ASL University: Thank you
sources.author: William Vicars / ASL University
sources.demonstration_notes_zh: 主手平掌，指尖从近唇处向接收者前伸并略向下；实际图片末姿可见掌面朝上。源说明提及微笑，并提醒与 GOOD 不同。
sources.palm_orientation: Start palm toward signer observed near 0.916-1.016 s; palm up at 1.516 s; exact 3D rotation remains an engineering approximation.
sources.movement: forward toward addressee with slight downward component
sources.nonmanual: smile mentioned by author; mechanical model does not validate this component

video_observation.method: Official ASLU page YouTube embed played at 0.25x; page frame-step buttons used; video DOM currentTime read alongside paused screenshots.

sampled_observations.observation_zh: 主手向下脸抬起，指尖近下巴。
指尖近唇，手背朝观察者，掌面朝签者自身。
仍在近唇位置；起始掌面朝内。
手离开口部向前，手指仍较竖。
手向前并略下，掌面开始朝上。
前伸终姿，平掌朝上，指尖朝接收者。
表达完成后手收回下垂。

video_observation.precision_limit: Browser sample times, not independently decoded frame timestamps; qualitative monocular observations only, no calibrated human 3D joints or ASL expert review.

sources.title: ASL University: WAIT
sources.author: William Vicars / ASL University
sources.demonstration_notes_zh: 文字要求双手抬起略偏侧并摆动手指。实际连续照片可见双掌朝上或斜上、手指张开与交替屈伸，一侧手可略高。该词例不证明完整 PLEASE_WAIT 礼貌请求。
sources.handshape: open spread fingers with finger wiggle
sources.location: raised in front and somewhat to the side; unequal heights observed
sources.movement: finger articulation; not a whole-hand repeated fist
sources.nonmanual: request pragmatics and politeness not verified from this lexical sample

sampled_observations.observation_zh: 双掌朝上或斜上，签者左手偏侧较高，右手前方较低。
掌位置总体相近，手指屈伸状态变化。
连续手指屈伸可见，不是整手全握拳。

sources.title: ASL University: please
sources.author: William Vicars / ASL University
sources.demonstration_notes_zh: 主手平掌在胸中央作圆周。作者讨论 PLEASE 的语境、表情和句末附加用法；不能仅按英文先 PLEASE 后 WAIT 拼接并声称语法已核验。
sources.palm_orientation: toward chest as indicated by placement
sources.nonmanual: facial expression and pragmatic context discussed as important

global_limits: No ASL-fluent human has reviewed the robot trajectories.
No downloaded human motion file or motion-capture data is claimed.
HELLO and THANK_YOU are lexical examples usable as candidate standalone acts, not proof of general sentence translation.
PLEASE_WAIT currently has lexical WAIT/PLEASE references only; phrase semantics and politeness remain unverified.
All authored robot coordinates, timing and interpolation are engineering approximations.

evaluation.freeze_rule: Final cases frozen before method execution; language implementer may inspect dev only. Keep failures; do not retune on final and call the rerun independent.
evaluation.scope: Text-to-candidate-ID selection only; excludes ASL intelligibility, clinical safety and robot playback approval.
evaluation.latency: One catalog-alias readiness/warmup call per method recorded separately; dataset calls measured end-to-end by the evaluator and include guards, selection and errors. Report median/P95/max. Local CPU scheduling can affect comparisons.
evaluation.missing_backend: Skip the whole method after an unguarded readiness call reports unavailable. Do not score guarded rows as LLM model results.
evaluation.llm: Disabled in the default evaluation; an explicitly requested existing local endpoint may be evaluated with --include-llm. No remote paid API.
